test.title: — Brainstorm Chapter Outline for Chapter 1 (Same Arc)
test.prompt: Create a chapter outline for Chapter 1 of "The Signal Beneath"
expected: briefs reflect book Ch1 brief (no drift); Prologue context injected (acknowledges prior events); Ch2 context injected (sets up hook); names match book outline; saved to outline; CR-009 email

response.assistant_message: Queuing the chapter outline for Chapter 1 of "The Signal Beneath" — I'll let you know when it's ready.

sub_chapter_briefs.title: The World Before
sub_chapter_briefs.beat: Protagonist moves through their ordinary daily routine, revealing what they love and what quietly unsettles them — a specific object, habit, or relationship signals that something is already slightly wrong beneath the surface.
sub_chapter_briefs.brief: Protagonist moves through their ordinary daily routine, revealing what they love and what quietly unsettles them — a specific object, habit, or relationship signals that something is already slightly wrong beneath the surface.
sub_chapter_briefs.arc_beat: Ordinary World — establish stakes before disruption
sub_chapter_briefs.setting: Protagonist's home or habitual daily environment, morning
sub_chapter_briefs.emotional_tone: Deceptive calm with an undercurrent of restlessness
sub_chapter_briefs.connects_to_book_arc: Anchors the reader in the world that will be destroyed or transformed — the loss of this world must matter later.

sub_chapter_briefs.title: The Thing That Is Already Wrong
sub_chapter_briefs.beat: A specific, concrete problem — a letter unopened, a person avoided, a debt unacknowledged — is revealed. The protagonist makes a small choice to ignore or defer it. ESCALATION SEED: this deferral is the lie/avoidance that will compound. Reappears with pressure ~ch.5; explodes ~ch.12.
sub_chapter_briefs.brief: A specific, concrete problem — a letter unopened, a person avoided, a debt unacknowledged — is revealed. The protagonist makes a small choice to ignore or defer it. ESCALATION SEED: this deferral is the lie/avoidance that will compound. Reappears with pressure ~ch.5; explodes ~ch.12.
sub_chapter_briefs.arc_beat: Inciting Pressure — the flaw or threat that already exists
sub_chapter_briefs.setting: Same environment, slightly later — a private moment
sub_chapter_briefs.connects_to_book_arc: Plants the escalating thread: a small avoidance now becomes the engine of later catastrophe.

sub_chapter_briefs.title: The Other Person
sub_chapter_briefs.beat: A second character enters — ally, antagonist, or complication. A specific exchange of dialogue reveals the relationship's tension or warmth AND delivers a piece of information the protagonist does not yet know how to use.
sub_chapter_briefs.brief: A second character enters — ally, antagonist, or complication. A specific exchange of dialogue reveals the relationship's tension or warmth AND delivers a piece of information the protagonist does not yet know how to use.
sub_chapter_briefs.arc_beat: World Population — introduce the relational stakes
sub_chapter_briefs.setting: A shared space — workplace, street, kitchen, threshold
sub_chapter_briefs.emotional_tone: Charged, watchful — affection and wariness coexist
sub_chapter_briefs.connects_to_book_arc: Establishes the human relationship whose fate will measure the protagonist's success or failure by the final chapter.

sub_chapter_briefs.title: The Inciting Event
sub_chapter_briefs.beat: Something happens that cannot be ignored or deferred. It is external, concrete, and irreversible — a message arrives, a confrontation occurs, a discovery is made. The protagonist's hope and fear from sub-chapter 1 are both activated simultaneously.
sub_chapter_briefs.brief: Something happens that cannot be ignored or deferred. It is external, concrete, and irreversible — a message arrives, a confrontation occurs, a discovery is made. The protagonist's hope and fear from sub-chapter 1 are both activated simultaneously.
sub_chapter_briefs.setting: The same environment or an immediate adjacent space — no time jump
sub_chapter_briefs.emotional_tone: Shock, then rapid calculation — the ground has shifted
sub_chapter_briefs.connects_to_book_arc: This is the hinge: everything before is the old life; everything after is the story. The book-level conflict is now in motion.

sub_chapter_briefs.title: The First Decision
sub_chapter_briefs.beat: The protagonist makes a concrete, active choice in response to the inciting event — not a plan, but an action taken or a door walked through. The choice is imperfect and will cost something. The chapter ends on a new dramatic question that pulls the reader into chapter 2.
sub_chapter_briefs.brief: The protagonist makes a concrete, active choice in response to the inciting event — not a plan, but an action taken or a door walked through. The choice is imperfect and will cost something. The chapter ends on a new dramatic question that pulls the reader into chapter 2.
sub_chapter_briefs.arc_beat: Crossing the Threshold — protagonist commits to the story
sub_chapter_briefs.setting: A liminal space — a doorway, a vehicle, a street — movement away from the ordinary world
sub_chapter_briefs.emotional_tone: Determined but afraid — no going back
sub_chapter_briefs.connects_to_book_arc: The protagonist is now an active agent in the book-level conflict. The reader's question — 'will they succeed?' — is fully formed and unresolved.
